اقتويتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَوَيْتُنَّ (iqtawaytunna) /iq.ta.waj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اُقْتُوِيتُنَّ (uqtuwītunna) /uq.tu.wiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
